title: Dreamcore: pastel tiled poolrooms, rollercoaster wave and rainbow CRT
note: Dreamcore aesthetic inspo. Posted by @dreamcore_core ('you've been here before.') on 2026-11-20, no caption. 14 s clip with sound: mint-tiled poolrooms flooding as a wave crashes in under a glowing pink rollercoaster at night; a pink-and-mint bathroom half underwater with pastel checker tiles and a beige CRT showing rainbow bars; a tiled water corridor with cotton clouds on the walls, neon tubes and a glowing pink doorway. Thumbnail is a frame from the clip.
